stemEn: A child with 3 days of cough and fever presented to the ER with abdominal pain and nonbilious vomiting for the last 6 hours. He looks toxic, tachypneic, and febrile. Abdominal examination shows quiet bowel sounds and voluntary guarding. What is your next step?
explanationAr: المصدر يفسر الصورة السريرية على أنها pneumonia مع referred abdominal pain، ولذلك يختار Chest X-ray. كما يذكر أن CXR قد يُظهر أيضًا free air إذا كان perforation موضع قلق.
reasoningEn: The source interprets the presentation as pneumonia with referred abdominal pain and selects chest radiography as the next test.
incorrectOptionsAr: Abdominal X-ray وUGI series لا يجيبان مباشرة عن الاشتباه التنفسي في هذا الـstem، وCBC قد يثبت وجود inflammation لكنه لا يحدد مصدره.
clinicalPearl: Lower-lobe pneumonia can present with abdominal pain in children.
diagnosticSteps: Obtain chest radiograph when pneumonia is suspected despite abdominal symptoms

stemEn: A mother brought her infant to clinic after noticing swelling in the left axilla. There were no other symptoms and no other abnormalities on examination. What will you do next?
explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يقول إن المعلومات غير كافية للحكم، وخاصة حجم التورم وكونه suppurative أو غير ذلك. لذلك لا تُختار إجابة بالقوة، ويُحفظ السؤال كـincomplete recall.
reasoningEn: The source explicitly states that more information is needed, particularly the size and clinical nature of the swelling.
clinicalPearl: Management of axillary lymphadenitis depends on size, suppuration, systemic symptoms and likely cause.
diagnosticSteps: Review BCG history and systemic symptoms

tts.text: An infant has isolated left axillary swelling with no other symptoms or examination abnormalities. What will you do next? A. Reassurance. B. Incision and drainage. C. Give antibiotics until it resolves. D. Give isoniazid for 6 weeks.

stemEn: A newborn came to clinic for a well-baby visit. A provided skin lesion showed axillary lymphadenitis. How will you manage him?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار reassurance and observation إذا كانت BCG lymphadenitis غير suppurative. لأن الصورة الأصلية جزء من السؤال ولم تُربط بعد، يبقى السؤال image_missing ويحتاج التأكد من أن الآفة فعلًا non-suppurative.
reasoningEn: The source selects observation for nonsuppurative BCG lymphadenitis and explicitly qualifies the answer by the absence of suppuration.
incorrectOptionsAr: Incision and drainage ليست الخطوة المختارة في الصورة غير المتقيحة حسب المصدر، وINH ليس العلاج الروتيني لهذا السيناريو كما هو مكتوب.
clinicalPearl: Nonsuppurative BCG lymphadenitis is often managed conservatively; suppuration changes management.
managementSteps: Reassess if enlargement or suppuration develops

stemEn: A 7-day-old neonate presented with bilateral purulent eye discharge, erythema, and swelling in the medial side of the eyes. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن Chlamydial conjunctivitis تظهر عادة خلال 5–14 يومًا من الولادة، وقد تبدأ من اليوم الثالث، وتسبب eyelid swelling وerythema وmucopurulent discharge. لذلك عمر 7 أيام يدعم A.
reasoningEn: The timing at day 7 and the bilateral mucopurulent conjunctivitis pattern match the source description of neonatal chlamydial conjunctivitis.
incorrectOptionsAr: Chemical irritation تكون أبكر عادة، lacrimal duct obstruction لا يعطي هذا النمط الالتهابي المميز، وNeisseria يحتاج سياقًا سريريًا مختلفًا في هذا السؤال.
clinicalPearl: Chlamydial conjunctivitis commonly becomes evident 5–14 days after birth.

stemEn: A patient presented with arthritis, conjunctivitis, and dysuria following an infection. What could be the possible causative organism?
explanationAr: المصدر يربط triad of arthritis + conjunctivitis + urethral symptoms بـ reactive arthritis، ويذكر Chlamydia كأحد أهم المسببات، لذلك إجابة التجميع A.
reasoningEn: The source states that Chlamydia is a common endemic trigger of reactive arthritis.
clinicalPearl: Reactive arthritis follows an infection elsewhere; classic teaching includes arthritis, urethritis and conjunctivitis.

tts.text: A patient has arthritis, conjunctivitis and dysuria after an infection. What could be the causative organism? A. Chlamydia.

stemEn: A patient presented with arthritis and conjunctivitis following an infection. Which finding would support the diagnosis of reactive arthritis?
explanationAr: المصدر يذكر التعريف التقليدي الضيق للـreactive arthritis كـpostinfectious arthritis مع urethritis وconjunctivitis، لذلك وجود urethritis يدعم التشخيص.
reasoningEn: The source notes the classic triad of postinfectious arthritis, urethritis and conjunctivitis.
clinicalPearl: The classic triad is arthritis, urethritis and conjunctivitis, although the complete triad is not always present.

tts.text: A patient has arthritis and conjunctivitis following an infection. Which finding supports reactive arthritis? A. The presence of urethritis.

stemEn: A patient presented with reactive arthritis. Which laboratory finding is most commonly associated with this diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن نسبة كبيرة من مرضى reactive arthritis تكون HLA-B27 positive، لذلك A هي إجابة التجميع.
reasoningEn: The source states that approximately 50%–80% of patients with reactive arthritis are HLA-B27 positive.
clinicalPearl: HLA-B27 is associated with reactive arthritis and other spondyloarthropathies.

tts.text: A patient has reactive arthritis. Which laboratory finding is most commonly associated with this diagnosis? A. Human leukocyte antigen HLA-B27.
